groups.title: Design
groups.summary: Five themes in light and dark; colours, typefaces, spacing and logo as site settings; own stylesheet, script and templates.

features.text: Five themes, each in light and dark
Colours, typefaces, spacing and logo as site settings
Own stylesheet, script and templates on top

groups.title: Content
groups.summary: Two containers and 12 content elements, a hero that can turn into a slideshow, galleries with a lightbox, video in an image's place and tables from the text editor.

features.text: Two containers and 12 content elements
A hero that turns into a slideshow, paused on request
Galleries that open in a lightbox
Video in an image's place, own files or YouTube and Vimeo
Tables from the text editor
A page with every element in each of its variants

groups.title: Core extensions
groups.summary: Forms with every element type and steps, login, search, news, the XML sitemap and structured data, all in the theme's own markup.

features.text: Forms with every element type, in steps
Login for members
Site search
News, as trail reports
XML sitemap and structured data

groups.title: Accessibility
groups.summary: WCAG 2.2 AA as the target: contrast checked in every theme and mode, keyboard use, large targets, marked external links, reduced motion.

features.text: WCAG 2.2 AA as the target
Contrast checked in every theme, light and dark
Skip link, visible focus, menus that close with Escape
External links marked, for eyes and screen readers
No motion when the system asks for less

groups.title: Privacy
groups.summary: Fonts from the site itself, YouTube and Vimeo only after the visitor's yes, no tracking and no cookies of the theme's own.

features.text: Fonts delivered from the site itself
YouTube and Vimeo only after the visitor's yes
No tracking, no cookies of its own

groups.title: Languages and print
groups.summary: English, German and Japanese throughout; pages print as content only, ink on white.

features.text: English, German and Japanese, interface included
Pages print as content only, ink on white

groups.title: For developers
groups.summary: Fluid components for other extensions, no fluid_styled_content, a manual, and checks for code, contrast, accessibility and size.

features.text: {components} Fluid components for other extensions
Runs without fluid_styled_content
A manual for integrators and editors
Checks for code style, contrast, accessibility and CSS size

groups.title: Demo and starter
groups.summary: A travel journal of a four-day walk in three languages, with its own route map and chapters, and five pages to start a site from.

features.text: A travel journal of a four-day walk, in three languages
Its own elements: a route map with linked stations and days, and chapters
A starter of five pages to build on
